events.title: Next Fest Live: Running the Shop - One More Day
events.summary: Next Fest is open, so I am running the demo live for a couple of hours.Dark Workshop Simulator is a first-person dark fantasy shop sim. Buy from suppliers, stock the shelves, set your prices against a market that argues back, and build up from one room into a forge and an alchemy lab. Your staff are zombies you raise yourself, and not every customer leaves peacefully.The demo is free and the 0.3.4 economy update just landed. Come watch, then go play it.

events.title: Demo 0.3.4: Economy Update
events.summary: Testers told me the early game felt like living paycheck to paycheck. Every coin went straight back into restocking, and the Alchemy Lab stayed out of reach for a week. events.title: Japanese Localization Added
events.summary: Dark Workshop now supports Japanese!Full translation across all game text: items, UI, suppliers, crafting, quests, and decoration descriptions. Noto Sans CJK font included for proper rendering. Switch languages anytime from the Settings menu! Also in this update: - Steam Wishlist and Discord buttons added to menus - Missing item translations fixed across all languages - Decoration bonus text now properly localized

events.title: Dark Workshop 0.3.0: Draw the Sigil, Pay the Crafter
events.summary: Dark Workshop 0.3.0Five weeks and two hundred and forty three commits. Crafting stopped being a button.Draw the sigil.Every craft now opens a full screen glyph and you trace it by hand, against a timer, with wet ink drying behind the nib. Run out of time or back out and you lose nothing, because the ingredients are only spent when the sigil closes. All six stations work this way.Watch it cook. events.title: Five languages, new display settings, and a wide-screen fix
events.summary: Five languagesThe shop now speaks English, Russian, German, Spanish and French. Every menu, item, recipe, contract and line of the Whispering Skull's dialogue is translated, and the game picks your system language automatically on first launch. You can change it any time in Settings.An honest note: every language other than English is machine translated and has not yet been reviewed by a native speaker. events.title: Dark Workshop 0.2.0: The Customers Are Not Grateful
events.summary: Dark Workshop 0.2.0The demo has had two weeks of heavy work. The shop is prettier, meaner, and considerably more opinionated about how you run it.Customers can turn on you. Most browse politely. Some sweep your stock onto the floor and take a swing at the furniture. Keep the hammer handy, or put a Guard on the payroll.Your furniture breaks. events.title: Update 0.1.3 - Journal System & Tutorial Rework
events.summary: This update focuses on giving players clearer direction after the tutorial and polishing the experience.Journal & ObjectivesPress J to open your Journal. Objectives unlock as your fame grows, reward gold on completion, and a waypoint system points you toward your next goal.Skip TutorialA checkbox on New Game lets returning players skip the tutorial entirely, with everything properly unlocked from the start.UI PolishRestyled multiple panels (Journal, Employee cards, Quest dialogs, Ordering view)

events.title: Update 0.1.2 - The Living Village Update
events.summary: The biggest update since the demo launched. The shop stopped being a vending machine and started being a place in a village.Word of MouthDemand is now earned. Assign an item to a shelf and word starts spreading. Keep it stocked and demand grows. Pull it and the village forgets. You can now specialize: run a potions shop, a weapons den, whatever you want. Nobody asks for things you never sold.Item RarityEvery item is now Common, Uncommon, or Rare. Rare stock brings better margins and more thieves
